jobs.title: Security Guard Texas Level III Armed Patrol Driver - Part Time
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard Texas Level III Armed Patrol Driver - Part Time in Austin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Armed Patrol Officer at a retail location, you will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, respond to security-related concerns, and provide outstanding customer service. This driving position requires a valid driver’s license and Level III Armed Certification. Join Allied Universal’s caring, agile team and bring integrity, reliability, and professionalism to every shift.

Position Type: Part Time

 Pay Rate: $26.50 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeFri06:00 AM - 02:45 PMSat06:00 AM - 02:45 PMSun06:00 AM - 02:45 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to customers, employees, and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents, disturbances, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established protocols and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols of retail sales areas, entrances, parking areas, loading docks, and the surrounding perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access points and observe customer and employee activity for potential security-related concerns, escalating issues to site leadership and/or emergency services as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate daily activity reports, incident documentation, and required equipment records in accordance with Allied Universal and site procedures.

Minimum Requirements

  • Possess at least 3 years of combined law enforcement, corrections, or military experience, or at least 5 years of armed security experience.
  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Possess a Level III Armed Certification in Texas.
  • Be at least 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Participate in industry-specific security training programs.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices. C15802

jobs.description:
NOW HIRING — COMMISSIONED SECURITY OFFICERS | Greater Austin

Starting at $23/hour | Full-Time + Overtime | Outdoor Foot Patrol

Ranger Protection Agency isn't looking for officers to sit in a vehicle and observe from a distance. We are a “Boots on the Ground — Resolve & Report” private security agency looking for qualified, like-minded professionals who are comfortable being proactive and handling issues on property.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Only applicants who meet ALL of the following will be considered at this time:

  • Current Texas Level III (Armed) Commissioned Security Officer License
  • Own firearm and at least one less-lethal option (O/C, baton, or Taser) with appropriate training/certification
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable personal vehicle
  • Currently live and/or work in the Greater Austin area
  • Able to pass a drug test

THE POSITION

These are outdoor foot-patrol positions at apartment communities and retail centers in the greater Austin area.

Our officers do more than observe and report. Ranger's Resolve & Report approach includes:

  • Addressing lease violations
  • Issuing Criminal Trespass Warnings
  • Utilizing lawful arrest authority when appropriate
  • Proactively addressing suspicious or criminal activity
  • Maintaining a visible security presence and interacting with residents, management, and law enforcement

For individuals interested in pursuing a career in law enforcement, Ranger provides an opportunity to gain relevant, hands-on field experience while developing communication, documentation, de-escalation, decision-making, and enforcement skills.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Starting at $23/hour

  • Full-time positions
  • Set weekly schedule
  • Bi-weekly pay
  • Subsidized health insurance
  • Accrued Paid Time Off
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discounts
  • Professional development assistance
  • Training and advancement opportunities

If you're looking for a security job where getting out, engaging, problem-solving, and making a difference on the properties you protect is the rule—not the exception—we want to hear from you.

Ranger Protection Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Description
Overview
The Armed Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of residents, visitors, and property within the apartment complex.
This position involves maintaining a visible presence, enforcing community rules, and responding to security incidents with professionalism and discretion.
Responsibilities
* Patrol the apartment grounds, parking lots, and common areas to deter unauthorized activity and ensure resident safety.
* Respond promptly to calls for service, disturbances, or suspicious activity.
* Enforce property policies and regulations while maintaining a respectful and professional demeanor with residents and guests.
* Conduct vehicle and foot patrols to prevent trespassing, vandalism, theft, and other unlawful acts.
* Prepare detailed hourly reports using our tracktik security system, on activities, incidents, and observations.
* Coordinate with law enforcement and emergency responders when necessary.
* Provide assistance to residents, management, and contractors as needed to maintain a safe environment.
Qualifications
* Must possess a valid armed security officer license or certification as required by state law.
* Proven experience in security, law enforcement, or military service preferred.
* Excellent communication and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to remain calm and act decisively during high-stress situations.
* Must be able to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods and work in various weather conditions.
* Professional appearance and conduct required at all times.
* Join us in ensuring safety and security within our community by applying for the Armed Security Officer position today!
Job Types: Full-time, Part-time

jobs.title: Armed Driver Guard
jobs.description: Job Description As an Armored Driver Guard, you work with your team to ensure the safe and secure pickup and delivery of cash, coin, and valuables. Responsibilities · Drive automatic armored vehicles and other vehicles on designated routes servicing customer locations · Service ATMs and Smart Safes · Service customer stops, including delivering customer change orders and picking up deposits. · Load/unload vehicle cargo including multiple bags and boxes of coins · Count items, record, and sign for cargo items · Other duties as assigned by management Requirements · At least 21 years of age · At least a 3 year driving record · Ability to obtain Medical Examiners Certificate via US Department of Transportation approved medical examiners · A valid firearms permit or ability to pass applicable firearms requirements may be required Loomis will pay for security and firearms qualifications, licensing and permitting. Working Conditions · Full-time schedule potentially consisting of an average 40 to 50 hours/week, with minimum of 5 days during a 6-day period. Occasional weekend work · Approximately 90-95 percent of work performed in air-conditioned vehicle within individual compartments (front and rear) Essential Duties/Job Qualifications As part of the qualification process for the Armed Driver Guard position, a Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) is required. This evaluation requires successful completion of testing in the following areas:Lift:- 25lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 66 inches from the floor (1X)Lift-Carry:- 18lbs vertical lift from 1 inch to 44 inches from the floor, and horizontally transfer 15ft (4X)- 18lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 300ft (1X)- 50lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 2ft (2X)Push-Pull:- Horizontally transfer 47lbs of force on a sled (single, non-dominant arm), a distance of 1ft (2X)Repetitive Coupling:- Squeeze Jamar Hand Dynamometer requiring forces up to 30lbs / both right & left hands (4X)Climb:- Ascend / Descend a step with heights of 16. 21 & 24 inches from the floor (10X) Benefits Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employees benefit packages in the industry, which includes: · Vacation and Sick Time (PTO) as well as Paid Holidays · Health & Dental Insurance · Vision Insurance · 401(k) Plan · Basic Life Insurance Plan · Voluntary Life Insurance Plan · Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account · Dependent Care Account · Industry leading Training and Development
